name: Radix Sort for Splat Depth
definition: Sorts projected splats by depth using a 2-pass 16-bit radix sort on the bit pattern of `f32` depths, leveraging the fact that positive float bit patterns preserve ordering when reinterpreted as `u32`.
summary: Radix Sort for Splat Depth sorts 3D Gaussian splats by depth using IEEE 754 bit patterns to achieve linear time complexity, enabling correct front-to-back alpha compositing.
